plugin.name: Compact_Pheal
plugin.author: Zargulis
plugin.description: Compact Pheal ------- Reduce pheal spam Type 'cpheal help' for usage

muclient.aliases: <alias match="^cpheal timer\s(?(\d*))$" regexp="y" enabled="y" sequence="100" script="set_timer" />

trigger.name: prefresh_capture
trigger.match: feels less tired after your refreshment

trigger.name: sheal_capture
trigger.match: A warm feeling fills your body

muclient.script:
require 'aardwolf_colors'
function init() pheal = 0 prefresh = 0 sheal = 0 srefresh = 0 sheal_count = 0
timer_enabled = GetVariable("timer_enabled") or true timer_enabled = tostring(timer_enabled) == "true"
timer_seconds = tonumber(GetVariable("timer_seconds")) or 5 SetTimerOption("pheal_timer", "second", timer_seconds)
cpheal_enabled = GetVariable("cpheal_enabled") or true cpheal_enabled = tostring(cpheal_enabled) == "true"
if cpheal_enabled then cpheal_enable() else cpheal_disable() end end
function colorsToAnsiNote(data) return AnsiNote(ColoursToANSI(data)) end
function cpheal_enable() cpheal_enabled = true SetVariable("cpheal_enabled", "true") EnableTriggerGroup("cpheal", true) EnableTimer("pheal_timer", timer_enabled) EnableTrigger("pheal_end", not timer_enabled) print ("Cpheal is enabled.") end
function cpheal_disable() cpheal_enabled = false SetVariable("cpheal_enabled", "false") EnableTimer("pheal_timer", false) EnableTriggerGroup("cpheal", false) EnableTrigger("pheal_end", false) EnableTrigger("blank", false) EnableTrigger("full", false) print ("Cpheal is disabled.") end
function timer_info() status = "" if timer_enabled then status = "enabled" else status = "disabled" end
print("The timer is " .. status .. " and set for " .. timer_seconds .. " seconds.") end
function timer_enable() timer_enabled = true SetVariable("timer_enabled", "true") EnableTrigger("pheal_end", false) EnableTimer("pheal_timer", true) print("Cpheal timer on. Prompt display off.") end
function timer_disable() timer_enabled = false SetVariable("timer_enabled", "false") EnableTrigger("pheal_end", true) EnableTimer("pheal_timer", false) print("Cpheal timer off. Prompt display on.") end
function set_timer(name, line, args) if tonumber(args.seconds) ~= nil then timer_enabled = true timer_seconds = args.seconds EnableTrigger("pheal_end", false) EnableTimer("pheal_timer", true) SetTimerOption("pheal_timer", "second", timer_seconds) SetVariable("timer_seconds", timer_seconds) print("Cpheal timer set to: " .. timer_seconds .. " seconds.") else print("Must be in the form: cpheal timer <number of seconds>") end end
function pheal_trigger_capture(name, line, args) pheal = pheal + string.match(line, "%[(%d*)]$") sheal_count = 0 end
function prefresh_trigger_capture(name, line, args) prefresh = prefresh + string.match(line, "%[(%d*)]$") sheal_count = 0 end
function sheal_trigger_capture(name, line, args) sheal = sheal + string.match(line, "%[(%d*)]$") sheal_count = sheal_count + 1 end
function srefresh_trigger_capture(name, line, args) srefresh = srefresh + string.match(line, "%[(%d*)]$") sheal_count = 0 end
function pheal_trigger_end() report = ""
if pheal > 0 or sheal > 0 or prefresh > 0 or srefresh > 0 then report = "@w<< In: @G[@W".. sheal .. "@G] @w| @C[@W" .. srefresh .. "@C] @w>> << Out: @G[@W".. pheal .. "@G] @w| @C[@W" .. prefresh .. "@C] @w>>" colorsToAnsiNote(report) pheal = 0 prefresh = 0 sheal = 0 srefresh = 0 end
sheal_count = 0 end
function blank_trigger(name, line, args) if sheal_count > 1 then DeleteLines(1) PlaySound (1, "waka-waka.wav", false, 0, 0) end end
function full_trigger() sheal_count = 0 end
function help() print("Compact Pheal") print("cpheal help -> duh") print("cpheal on/off -> duh. on by default") print("cpheal timer -> displays timer status") print("cpheal timer on/off -> turns timed display on and prompt display off, or vice versa - on by default") print("cpheal timer <seconds> -> enables and sets the timer, disables prompt display - 5 by default") end
function OnPluginInstall() help() init() end
